patterns.what_worked: Evidence-first Step 1 settled the discriminator: the addon's own main.lua:1471-1479 documents world mouseover reaching the hook menu-classified (parent=UIParent via GameTooltipMixin), so mouse focus (WorldFrame) + live mouseover unit separates it from bag/panel/addon surfaces even when both arrive with identical frame args; re-hover pins seeded to that exact shape kept their pre-fix redness, and both revert directions were proven per pin on an isolated copy.
patterns.what_was_hard: The mirror cannot show when the engine fires OnTooltipSetDefaultAnchor (C-side), so the bag route had to be inferred from the operator's in-game report plus mixin wiring; one luajit suite failure during the first concurrent run never reproduced (7 full runs + 30 standalone repeats green) and its output was truncated before capture.
patterns.skill_gap: Capture full suite output before tail-filtering on first runs of any interpreter, so a one-off failure cannot arrive undetailed.
